events.title: NI Tech Awards 2025: Women in Tech Belfast wins Best Meetup of the Year
events.note: Invite-only awards night across 11 categories. Women in Tech Belfast won Best Meetup of the Year (listed as “Women in Tech” on the official winners page), beating NI Cyber Breakfast Club, The Growth Network and the MCS Group Data Meetup.
events.imageAlt: Women in Tech Belfast and community members celebrating with the Best Meetup of the Year award at the NI Tech Awards 2025

news.t: Lorna McAdoo named Outstanding Woman in Tech
news.p: The Chair of Software NI and Group Director ESG at Version 1 took the top award at the fifth Women in Tech Awards. All finalists joined the Women in Tech Awards Alumnae network.
700 girls attended at ICC Belfast, the largest event of its kind in the region. Women hold just 23% of tech roles in Northern Ireland.

news.t: Women Techmakers Belfast marks its 10th conference
news.p: A decade of the International Women’s Day conference: 148 speakers and 1,600 attendees in total. Next one: March 2027.

news.p: At the invite-only NI Tech Awards 2025, run by MCS Group as part of Belfast Tech Week, the community beat three other shortlisted meetups for the title.

Organises the Women in Tech Awards and the Women in Tech Conference at Titanic Belfast.
